title: Timeline in History screen is not Always correct
symptom: In the history screen, while switching scale, the timeline is not correct for 6 and 12 hours. For 6 hours, the current hour appears two times; for 12 hours, the graph is one hour wrong (e.g., 7 instead of 8).
cause: The issue is a bug in the library and therefore unsolvable, as stated by MilosKozak in previous issues.
evidence_quote: Sorry, I just found that there are previous issues that raise the same point and @MilosKozak has said that it is a bug in the library and therefore unsolvable.
